introHtml: Snugz bag clips offer a secure seal that keeps chips, snacks, and dry goods fresh longer. Their patented design with interlocking teeth grips bags tightly, making them ideal for break rooms, trade shows, or retail giveaways. Available in 4-inch and 6-inch sizes, these clips can be decorated with your logo via pad printing or debossing for a clean, professional look that stands out on any pantry or desk.
